cube_number.description: Calculates the cube of a given number.

divide_numbers.description: Divides a number by another number, handling division by zero.

factorial.description: Computes the factorial of a non-negative integer.

fibonacci.description: Generates the first n numbers of the Fibonacci sequence.

health_check_system.description: Runs a series of checks to verify the integrity and existence of essential directories and files in a system.

inspect_manager_section.description: Finds any section in manager.py by keyword match and returns up to 60 lines of context around the first strong match.

list_files.description: List files in a directory, excluding hidden files and sorted alphabetically.

migrate_error_handling.description: Migrates error handling from return str(e) to raise Exception(str(e)) in Python tools.

multiply_string.description: Repeats a given string by a specified number of times.

read_file.description: Reads the content of a file from disk, preserving newlines and returning it as a structured dict.

read_webpage.description: Extracts and returns the text content of a webpage, excluding scripts and stylesheets.

rebuild_tool_index.description: Rebuilds the tool index by scanning tools directory and registering tools.

run_python.description: Executes a Python code snippet and returns its output.

run_system_maintenance.description: Runs system maintenance tasks to ensure infrastructure and functional tests are healthy and up-to-date.

self_test_system.description: A system for testing and verifying the integrity of AI LAB's tools and agents.

square_number.description: Calculates the square of a given number.

square_root.description: Compute the square root of a given number.

subtract_numbers.description: Subtracts two numbers and returns the result.

web_search.description: Search using DuckDuckGo HTML endpoint and returns real search results with titles, URLs, and snippets.

finalize_output.description: Returns the provided text as a finalized execution output.

write_file.description: Writes content to a file inside the MutesHand project directory.

grep.description: Search for a regex pattern inside files under the MutesHand project directory. Returns structured matches with file path, line number, and matching line text.

glob.description: Discover files matching a glob pattern under the MutesHand project directory. Returns structured list of matching paths.

edit_file.description: Replace exact string occurrences in a file. Supports dry_run preview and replace_all. Safer alternative to full file overwrite.
